summary: Tessa outbox meeting mode. Adds nullable tessa_outbox.meeting_mode (calendar_only | invite | online, CHECK-constrained) so a staged meeting releases as the kind of calendar entry Ed asked for. NULL keeps the legacy Teams-invite behavior for rows staged earlier. Additive only: no row, grant, trigger or function changes.

expected_changes: Adds column tessa_outbox.meeting_mode text, nullable, no default.
Adds CHECK constraint tessa_outbox_meeting_mode_check: NULL or one of calendar_only, invite, online.
No row changes; existing rows read NULL (legacy Teams invite). Grants unchanged.
